description: Commission of Elections  - Notifying that the Revision of Registers of Elections for the Year 2016 has Commenced on 16.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette content announces the commencement of the revision of registers of electors for 2016, specifies where copies of electoral registers will be exhibited, and describes the process for public verification and enumeration. It directly relates to electoral processes and voter registration matters under the Registration of Electors Act, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
